result.hard_numeric_fact_text: FACT: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs2,982 cr, +16% YoY (NSE press-release title 2026-08-13); CARE upgraded Crosslay Remedies (ex-Jaypee Healthcare) LT facilities to AA+ Stable and removed Rating Watch (NSE 2026-10-09). Dossier: revenue +16.7%, EBITDA +14.4%, PAT +4.9%.
result.thesis: Max Healthcare is a quality hospital compounder with healthy cash conversion (CFO/PAT 1.13), low leverage and AA+ ratings, but there is no early-inflection evidence: revenue +16.7% is steady, not accelerating, EBITDA margin is down 0.5pt, PAT +4.9% lags EBITDA, receivables grew 41% vs revenue 19%, and TTM P/E 58x already prices years of growth. Expected value is near zero with a deep derating bear case.
